claims.statement: On 2026-10-10, zimaboard-2 lost kubelet health and its Argo controller stalled reconciliation; automatic eviction and replacement restored reconciliation by 22:38:34 UTC without manual mutation. Memory and I/O pressure suggested a resource stall without proving its cause. Capacity, controller placement and alerting require reviewed follow-up; stale application status requires revision checks, and the PostgreSQL PVC writer requires fencing.
